grammar.title: Once, in the past with 曾经
grammar.pattern: (主语) + 曾经 + 动词短语
grammar.explanation: 曾经 (céngjīng) marks that something happened at some point in the past, but may not still be true — like English "once, at one time". It goes before the verb and pairs naturally with 过 to show past experience.

grammar.title: Continuing on with V + 下去
grammar.explanation: 下去 (xiàqù) after a verb shows that an ongoing action will continue into the future — "keep on doing something". It's often used to encourage someone to persist, or to describe something that keeps happening.

sentences.en: Does he agree or not, after all?

sentences.zh: 虽然很忙，他仍然每天运动。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán hěn máng, tā réngrán měi tiān yùndòng.
sentences.en: Even though he's busy, he still exercises every day.

sentences.zh: 已经十点了，他仍然在工作。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐjīng shí diǎn le, tā réngrán zài gōngzuò.
sentences.en: It's already ten o'clock, and he's still working.

sentences.zh: 这个问题仍然没有解决。
sentences.en: This problem still hasn't been solved.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū hěn zhídé kàn.
sentences.en: This book is really worth reading.

sentences.zh: 他说的话值得我们好好想想。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō de huà zhídé wǒmen hǎohāo xiǎngxiang.
sentences.en: What he said is worth thinking over carefully.
This is worth being happy about.
